name: OpenFlights
tagline: Open airline, airport, and route datasets for aviation apps
description: OpenFlights publishes downloadable reference datasets for airports, airlines, routes, planes, and countries. Widely used as a static aviation data source rather than a live query API; data is typically consumed via CSV downloads from openflights.org.

auth.details: No authentication required; data files are publicly downloadable

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free open data downloads; no API request limits published

use_cases: look up airport coordinates by IATA code from airports.dat
build airline route graphs from routes.dat
resolve airline names and ICAO codes from airlines.dat
seed local aviation reference DBs for flight apps
map airport timezones for schedule UIs
